title: Normalized Provider Event v1 (PINNED COPY)
description: PINNED COPY of the producer-owned contract for the normalized, schema-versioned event emitted by fast-api-eda-gateway on the afk.events topic. This file is NOT a producer-owned source artifact: it is a consumer-side transcription pinned from the producer sources `src/fast_api_eda_gateway/normalized_event.py` (build_normalized_event, SCHEMA_VERSION='1.0', EVENT_TYPE='normalized', LIFECYCLE_ALLOWLIST) and `src/fast_api_eda_gateway/normalized_event_producer.py` (build_normalized_message outbound whitelist). Provenance: see docs/afk-outcome-contract-validation.md; refresh this copy when the producer's normalized_event.py / normalized_event_producer.py change. The outbound message places schema_version and event_type first, then the whitelisted fields provider, delivery_id, resource, action, occurred_at, ingested_at, actor, redacted_payload — and nothing else (the producer whitelist drops any other key).

schema_version.description: Producer schema version — always "1.0" for v1 messages.

event_type.description: Producer event type distinguishing normalized events from AFK-batch/review messages on the shared transport — always "normalized".

delivery_id.description: Forwarded provider delivery UUID (X-GitHub-Delivery / X-GitLab-Event-UUID). Never null: anonymous deliveries are not produced. The consumer delivery_log dedup key.

resource.description: The nested resource identity object: producer-native type, repository URL, and provider number.

type.description: Producer-native resource vocabulary: issue, pull_request (GitHub), or merge_request (GitLab). Never the outcome layer's canonical change_request.

repository_url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) repository URL (GitHub repository_url; GitLab project_url).

number.description: Provider issue/PR/MR number (may be null when the provider omitted it; the producer coerces null to '' for its partition key only).

action.description: Producer canonical lifecycle action (top-level, never inside resource). Constrained per resource.type by the allOf clauses below to the producer lifecycle allowlist.

occurred_at.description: When the activity happened at the source (ISO 8601), emitted exactly as the provider sends it; null when the provider omits a timestamp (ingested_at is the fallback reference).

actor.description: Acting principal (GitHub sender; GitLab creator_username). Null for events with no actor.

redacted_payload.description: Carries only the redacted-payload *reference* — never raw or redacted payload content. The reference must equal the envelope's provider/delivery_id.

provider.description: Must equal the envelope's top-level provider.

delivery_id.description: Must equal the envelope's top-level delivery_id.
